correctness.rationale: Normalize positive heterogeneous quadratic cost coefficients via v_i=sqrt(gamma_i)x_i, y_i=b_i/sqrt(gamma_i), t=g/sqrt(gamma1 gamma2) in (0,1). Triangular best responses give unique Nash v=(y1+t y2,y2). Planner Hessian H=[[1,-t],[-t,1]] is positive definite and H^-1y nonnegative, giving unique feasible maximizer. Welfare at Nash is D/2 with D=(y1+t y2)^2+y2^2>0; planner welfare is (y1^2+2t y1y2+y2^2)/(2(1-t^2)). Ratio differences factor exactly into t^2*y1*(y1+2t*y2)/((1-t^4)D) and t^2*y2^2/((1-t^2)D); equality iff y1=0 or y2=0 respectively. Connected incentive path attains every value; strictly positive incentives exclude endpoints. For t>=1 welfare diverges along v1=v2; the Nash response matrix is nilpotent M^2=0 at every t. Independent exact rational welfare evaluations passed 192 cases, not used for the universal proof.
